about: Golden vectors for routine alarm rings. abera.tech (C#) and the iPhone app (Swift) hold the same file, byte for byte, and each has a test that reads it.
Each vector is a routine, an IANA zone, and a window. rings lists every ring of the routine itself in the window, soonest first.
The window is closed at both ends: a ring exactly at from or exactly at until is listed.
A ring at or before the routine's updatedAt is not listed. A vector with no updatedAt was saved long before its window.
stamp is the ring's scheduled local date and time, yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm. at is the instant it rings, in UTC.
summary is the text the page and the phone show for the repeat.
A change to this file is made in both repositories, and the SHA-256 each test holds changes with it.
